record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace each block's GELU feed-forward path with SwiGLU: two parallel d-to-2d projections, SiLU gating and a 2d-to-d output projection. Content-dependent gating may improve selective interactions after the successful feed-forward narrowing. Preserve bidirectional attention, pre-norm residuals, features, tied normalized embeddings, masking, appended-mask readout, loss and optimizer. Update predictor construction to match; retain one model per category.

+class SwiGLUEncoderLayer(nn.TransformerEncoderLayer):
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.linear_gate = nn.Linear(
+            self.linear1.in_features,
+            self.linear1.out_features,
+            bias=self.linear1.bias is not None,
+        )
+
+    def _ff_block(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        gated = torch.nn.functional.silu(self.linear_gate(x)) * self.linear1(x)
+        return self.dropout2(self.linear2(self.dropout(gated)))
+
+    def forward(self, src: torch.Tensor, src_mask=None,
+                src_key_padding_mask=None, is_causal: bool = False) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x = src
+        x = x + self._sa_block(
+            self.norm1(x), src_mask, src_key_padding_mask,
+            is_causal=is_causal,
+        )
+        x = x + self._ff_block(self.norm2(x))
+        return x

category_rationales.rationale: Replace the 2d GELU feed-forward path with SwiGLU in every category's BERT4Rec blocks. Two parallel d-to-2d projections provide content-dependent gating while preserving bidirectional attention, pre-norm residuals, embeddings, masking, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, keeping checkpoint construction consistent. Explicit forward dispatch ensures training and inference both use SwiGLU.
